extraction_notes: The supplied five-page datasheet is titled HL3401A P-CHANNEL MOSFET and is marked Rev:1.1.
P-channel numeric values are represented as positive magnitudes for model fitting; source polarity is retained in conditions where applicable.
Output, transfer, and capacitance traces were digitized directly from the plotted curves on p. 3 Figs. 1, 2, and 5 at selected axis positions without interpolation between plotted observations.
The transfer plot has separate Ta = 125 degC and Ta = 25 degC traces. The output plot has VGS = -10 V, -4.5 V, -3 V, -2.5 V, and -2 V traces, all under the p. 3 Ta = 25 degC heading.
Fig. 5 plots Ciss, Coss, and Crss against -VDS; the figure does not state frequency, while the tabulated capacitances are specified at f = 1 MHz.

The three published RDS(ON) rows have typical values of 50 mOhm at VGS = -10 V and ID = -4.2 A, 60 mOhm at VGS = -4.5 V and ID = -4.0 A, and 75 mOhm at VGS = -2.5 V and ID = -1.0 A; corresponding maximum values are 65 mOhm, 75 mOhm, and 90 mOhm.

Other transcribed datasheet values not represented by dedicated schema fields include IDSS maximum 1 uA at VDS = -24 V and VGS = 0 V, IGSS maximum ±100 nA at VGS = ±12 V and VDS = 0 V, gFS minimum 7.0 S at VDS = -5.0 V and ID = -5.0 A, maximum body-diode current 1.0 A, and switching times of 6.3 ns turn-on delay, 3.2 ns rise, 38.2 ns turn-off delay, and 12 ns fall under VGS = -10 V, VDS = -15 V, RL = 3.6 ohm, and RGEN = 6.0 ohm.
Thermal data include RthetaJA maximum 357 degC/W at steady state; the datasheet note specifies a 1 in2 FR-4 board with 2 oz copper in still air at Ta = 25 degC.
